foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification

capture_method.channel: ChatGPT web retrieval of public exchange REST endpoints
capture_method.hashes_are: SHA-256 of the exact JSON response body strings surfaced by the retrieval tool; not hashes of HTTP wire bytes or headers

reasons: USD and USDT are not normalized.
Kraken supplied no provider event timestamp.
Only one top-of-book level was captured for each venue; multi-level executable depth is absent.
The two observations were retrieved through the same collection channel and are not proven to share an identical exchange-event cutoff.
Fees, slippage, transfer costs and fill probability were not measured.
cross_venue_comparison.interpretation: The raw gap is not an arbitrage signal, directional edge or proof of cross-venue price dislocation.

source_independence.venue_origins: Kraken and OKX are distinct exchange-origin sources.
source_independence.collection_channel: Both response bodies were retrieved through the same web retrieval channel; this is not independent collection-channel corroboration.

access_failures.coinbase_spot_ticker: Endpoint not accessible through this retrieval path.
access_failures.kraken_depth: Endpoint not accessible through this retrieval path.
access_failures.okx_order_book: Endpoint not accessible through this retrieval path.
access_failures.binance_spot_depth: Endpoint not accessible through this retrieval path.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Kraken is about 0.347% below its UTC daily open and 24h VWAP; OKX is about 1.638% below its rolling 24h open.
disconfirming: Kraken daily open and OKX rolling 24h open are different windows.
One observation cannot establish trend persistence.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Kraken displayed larger best-bid than best-ask size, while OKX displayed substantially larger best-ask than best-bid size.
disconfirming: Only one level per venue was captured.
Displayed orders can be cancelled and are not fills.
The observations are not proven to share an identical event cutoff.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The current evidence is insufficient to distinguish broader selling pressure from venue-specific quoting, spread and timing effects.
disconfirming: Requires synchronized depth, trade aggressor flow, derivatives and repeated observations to test.

reasons: Kraken provider event timestamp is absent.
USD and USDT are not normalized.
Only Level-1 ticker sizes are available; full order-book depth is absent.
No synchronized multi-venue capture, trade aggressor flow, fees, slippage or fill probability.
Binance derivatives and Coinbase/other venue data were inaccessible through this retrieval path.
